map.由速度变化与加速度求位移 使用指南: Displacement from Velocity Change and Acceleration User Guide
map.已知末速度 v、初速度 v₀ 与加速度 a 时，按公式 s = (v² − v₀: Given final velocity v, initial velocity v₀ and acceleration a, solve the displacement with s = (v² − v₀²) / (2a) — no time parameter needed, ideal for back-analysis of uniformly accelerated rectilinear motion.
map.输入末速度 v、初速度 v₀、加速度 a，求位移。: Enter final velocity v, initial velocity v₀ and acceleration a to solve the displacement.
map.不知时间，用起末速度与加速度求位移。: Time unknown; back out displacement from the initial/final velocities and acceleration.
map.未知时间时，由初末速度与加速度反推位移。: When time is unknown, back out displacement from the initial/final velocities and acceleration.
map.：s = (20²−10²)/(2×5) = (400−100)/10 = 30: : s = (20²−10²)/(2×5) = (400−100)/10 = 30 m. That is, accelerating uniformly from 10 to 20 covers 30 metres.
map.初速 5 m/s，末速 25 m/s，加速度 4 m/s²: Initial speed 5 m/s, final speed 25 m/s, acceleration 4 m/s²
map.：s=(v²−v₀²)/(2a)=(625−25)/8=75.000 m。这条式: : s=(v²−v₀²)/(2a)=(625−25)/8=75.000 m. This formula needs no time term at all, suiting cases where only speed measurement points are available.
map.a 取负值即可；如 20→10、a=−5，s=(100−400)/(−10)=3: a can simply be negative; e.g. 20→10, a=−5, s=(100−400)/(−10)=30 m, and the distance comes out positive.
map.负的位移结果是错了吗？: Is a negative displacement result wrong?
map.不是。位移带方向：若取初速度方向为正、加速度为负（减速后反向），或末速平方小于初: No. Displacement carries direction: if the initial velocity direction is taken as positive and the acceleration is negative (decelerating into reverse), or the final speed squared is less than the initial speed squared, the result is negative, meaning the net displacement is opposite to the initial velocity. Numerically it is correct.
